title: Custom AttentionProcessor lost/fallback occurring after forward pass
author: abdullahejazjanjua

comments.author: abdullahejazjanjua
comments.body:
I'm closing this issue because I have identified that this is the intended behavior. In my custom processor, I was wrapping the `LoRAAttnProcessor2_0` class. Since the `LoRAAttnProcessor2_0` class contains a destructive reassignment. It replaces `attn.processor` with `AttnProcessor2_0` during its first `__call__`, my wrapper was effectively "self-destructing" after the first forward pass.

I suggest adding a warning or `logger.info` in `LoRAAttnProcessor2_0` to inform users when this internal overwrite occurs, as it can be very difficult to debug -- I am happy to open a PR to add this logging if you think it would be a helpful addition to the library.

Thanks.
